literal_meaning: unnecessary fuss or verbal commotion (word-for-word: abundance of pointless agitation)
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই ভাইয়ের মধ্যে ফইজত শুরু হয়ে গেছে।
এসব ফইজতে না জড়িয়ে কাজে মন দাও।
example_sentences_in_english: A fuss has started between the two brothers.
Don't get involved in such commotions and focus on your work.
note: The idiom likely derives from Persian-influenced Bengali, where 'ফয়জত' implies excessive or unwarranted agitation in speech.
